list: the official 55 trophies, as published on PSN (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026)

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trueachievements.name: TrueAchievements — Grand Theft Auto VI achievements

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is required (PowerPyx). It will be the last trophy you earn, so plan the run around A Long Road — the 100% checklist is the longest job on the list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is an automatic story trophy — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?”, and it is automatic — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, “Welcome to Vice City”. Automatic story trophy, nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, “Starting From Zero”. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy and it is automatic — PowerPyx lists the same final mission as the end of Chapter 4, so finishing the story is all it takes.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child’s Play in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, found after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be done in free-roam afterwards. PowerPyx stresses the requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals through binoculars, finish any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret’s quests need to be done in full. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy on the list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them freely; PowerPyx says under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. PowerPyx says you will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations (PowerPyx). The 100% checklist also needs the ranges done in full, so this is not a detour — it is part of the main grind. Gold medals here are not too difficult, per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total (PowerPyx). One win per location is enough; you do not need to win every race at each spot.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many races as you need — pick the short, easy ones and skip any that give you trouble.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui (Meet Cal)”, Cal will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal’s fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game (“Video Games” in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home with the controllers from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of one game at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge in it. Pick whichever you like best (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s optional questline, which is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of it stays available after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s optional questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission “Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)”: he calls, then is marked by the green “KR” icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons, you find the treasure with the metal detector and bring it back. After the first set he calls you back for more. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so he is not missable (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break” at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of it stays available after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Careful: only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counters per PowerPyx are Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (plane deliveries); PowerPyx notes more strangers are yet to be discovered, so check the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count. Everything stays available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s optional questline, “Randy’s Wish List”, marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS”, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered; track them under Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List, and find him at the green “RK” icon in the west of Vice City. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage — good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can steal them anywhere; sports cars are common in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Doable after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s optional questline — Jason only, marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy enough of them in “Take Out Kitty Litter” and Tyrone hands you the second quest, “Spin On This”, which unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts as +2, and the final spot only opens once you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2, “Coffee Break”). Track your count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY (PowerPyx; GTABase and Beebom agree): the first meditation, at Jason’s house in Chapter 1. After the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose “Accept”. It adds +1 to the counter, but it is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway. Safety net: the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and PowerPyx recommends keeping a save at the start and end of every chapter; make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 and another right after the balcony meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”: playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret marking “Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)” in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them back as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle “Killtelligence SM-69”, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. There are 15 Target Decks and all 15 are needed for 100%, so this comes naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy — work through Bret’s quests and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations in its collectible guide — you only need three full sets, so work on the sets whose cards you keep finding and leave the rest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 on objects in the world. PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in total, so scan whichever 100 you pass first.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 categories of 10). The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Earliest chance is after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, when you can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; shoot down a chasing helicopter if you must. PowerPyx’s easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red “heat” zone, not the flashing search area. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”, since the large bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — you need to stay in the red/blue flashing wanted state, not the red heat state. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then loot three robbery targets (green icons) back to back. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not unlock, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” — rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and do not leave the first store before the police arrive (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops automatically on the way (PowerPyx). Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First buff your focus with food, drinks, or washing your face/showering at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at Gang Operations work best — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 (full-auto, more accurate than pistols and SMGs). PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) and grows by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you reach Focus level 4 this comes much easier, and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge with the door straight into the plane (or walk in through the terminal). Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies, marked automatically with a green icon in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm); the gadget stays in your inventory permanently. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)” — it is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for a guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in fast and rob it. Bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). Afterwards, pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3 — for security-van tips: finish his Payday Loans quests first, then he sells tips for $10,000 and marks vans with a purple icon. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops automatically. Each vault pays up to $205,000, and robbing one instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” teaches bank vault robberies, and robbing a vault counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck to the bank, get into the vault, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay ’n’ Spray). Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, this pops on its own. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — the trophy only pops after you escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog on the map until the entire map is visible (PowerPyx). Do it late, after the story, when you have a plane and nothing else pulling you around the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy pops automatically on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no second guide has verified the method yet. PowerPyx reports: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar. That is a single early-guide report, so treat the bar, the drink and the spot as unconfirmed until another guide or your own play confirms them. The official description (“enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach”) fits a rooftop bar on Ocean Beach, which is why this report is plausible — but plausibility is not confirmation.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)”. Hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee works, not any other car; PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”, which is marked automatically. The three items: the Luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun “Gutterball Moreland 850” on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character, scroll to “Strength”, the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership, always go together (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner) — while you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty around Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that affects your reputation you will see a small demon face on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that PowerPyx says to avoid, since cops get more aggressive. It should come passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the method. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The official description (“Second time’s the charm”) suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, but that is only a reading of the description, not a confirmed step — do not chase a guessed method. Wait for a guide to confirm it, then check back here.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Confirmed by PowerPyx (updated 20 Nov 2026): this is the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy pops. PowerPyx warns the spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so you may need a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Confirmed by PowerPyx (updated 20 Nov 2026): ride any motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — PowerPyx suggests Vice City or Ocean Beach — so you can chain ten kicks before the timer runs out. Keep your speed low enough to stay near the crowd and kick (Square) as you pass each pedestrian.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew)”, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to bring it all at once. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way, per PowerPyx, is buying guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive things in the shops. Spending counts across every shop type (Ammu-Nation, mod shops, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, tattoo studios, electronics), so just buy what you actually want and the total adds up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission “Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)” — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”, and lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots, and you need spots to register vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose “Respray” and then “Register”. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay ’n’ Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down (PowerPyx).
